_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your actual values.
_multi_wiki_tip: For multiple wikis: either create one config per wiki, OR use one shared config and override wiki_clone_dir + mapping_file via --wiki-dir and --mapping-file CLI flags.
_wiki_clone_dir_help: Path to the folder created by: git clone <your-ado-wiki-url> my-wiki
_confluence_base_url_help: Your Atlassian domain — do NOT include /wiki at the end.
_confluence_space_key_help: Short space key — found in the Confluence URL after /spaces/
_confluence_parent_page_id_help: Page ID of the Confluence page that will be the root parent. Find it in the page URL: /pages/XXXXXXXXX/. Can be overridden per-run with --parent-page-id.
_mapping_file_help: Where to save migration progress. IMPORTANT: use a different mapping file per wiki (e.g. mapping-wiki1.json, mapping-wiki2.json). Can be overridden with --mapping-file.
_include_paths_help: Migrate only these ADO paths. e.g. ["/Products", "/Architecture"]. Leave [] for all pages.
_exclude_paths_help: Skip these ADO paths. e.g. ["/Products/Archive"]. Leave [] to skip nothing.
_log_file_help: Path to the log file. Every run appends to this file with timestamps. Set to null to disable file logging. Default: migration.log
_ssl_section: === SSL SETTINGS (only needed on corporate/proxy networks) ===
_ssl_verify_help: Set to false if you get SSL certificate errors. Run fix_ssl.py for a proper fix.
_ssl_cert_path_help: Optional: path to your company CA cert. Run fix_ssl.py to generate it.
